text: What actually pops when you crack your knuckles? Here's the chain. You pull the joint. The fluid inside loses pressure. A gas cavity forms in a flash. That's the pop. MRI scans caught it happening. The bubble stays behind for a while. And one doctor cracked only his left hand for sixty years. No arthritis in either hand. It's a bubble, not damage.
